dedupe_keys.name: maximizing storage in island park reservoir idaho and meeting constraints for the henry s fork trout fishery

description: Maximizing Storage in Island Park Reservoir, Idaho and Meeting Constraints for the Henry’s Fork Trout Fishery is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Christina Morrisett (deposited on HydroShare). This report uses linear optimization to identify a monthly reservoir release strategy that maximizes end-of-water-year storage in Island Park Reservoir, while also satisfying habitat and flow requirements for fish and anglers. Using historic data, I explore how these strategies change across different hydrologic regimes and which fishery constraints are the most limiting. Coverage: Idaho, United States. The resource was created 2018-11-12 and last updated 2018-12-10; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
